objective: Generate first N terms of the Fibonacci sequence in memory.
theory: Fibonacci sequence: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).
algorithm: 2. Read term count N into C.
4. Add previous two terms (A = B + D) to get next term.
5. Store term in memory, shift terms, repeat until C=0.
assembly_code:
LXI H, 2050H ; HL -> memory start
MVI B, 00H   ; 1st term = 0
MVI D, 01H   ; 2nd term = 1
MOV M, B    ; Store 1st term
INX H
MOV M, D    ; Store 2nd term
INX H
MVI C, 05H   ; Remaining terms N-2 = 5
LOOP: MOV A, B ; A = term 1
ADD D       ; A = term 1 + term 2
MOV M, A    ; Store next term
MOV B, D    ; Shift term 2 -> term 1
MOV D, A    ; Shift next term -> term 2
INX H
DCR C
JNZ LOOP
HLT
